original: iti kāmasūtrokteḥ vaidagdhyādanyo'pyartho bhaṅgyā prakāśyate/ yathā - suśliṣṭaguṇatayā mādhuryādibhirguṇaiḥ susambaddhatayā/ sanniveśaḥ śarīresaṃsthānam/ ramaṇīyo hṛdayahārī/ kutūhalinī tasya tādṛśasya darśanādutkaṇṭhitā/ abhinavo'ciradṛṣṭatvena bhavatastataḥ prabhṛti jātatvānnūtanaḥ/ athavā anyasya tādṛśasyābhilāṣaduḥkhasyādṛṣṭatvādvā/

original: vicitro vividhaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'vasthāntarakaraṇāt/ kusumeṣuvyāpāraḥ kusumāni puṣpāṇīṣavaḥ śarā yasya tasya kusumeṣorvyāpāraḥ śaravarṣaṇarūpā pravṛttiḥ/ vaidagdhyasya ubhayagatasya kalākauśalasya/ ramaṇīyatāyāḥ ubhayāśritasyākārasaundaryādeḥ/ nirmāṇaṃ brahmakartṛkā sṛṣṭiḥ/ sarasa eva lakṣaṇayānavakṣiptakāla eveti tasyāḥ kālāntarākṣamatvaṃ dyotyate/

original: saharṣamiti svāśāsitasyaiva saṃpatteḥ/ kiṃ nāma mālatīti/ mālatīti kiṃ saṃjñetyarthaḥ/ diṣṭyā vilasitaṃ bhagavatā daivena kusumāyudhena ca/ vilasitamiti bhāve niṣṭhā/ daivena kusumāyudhena ca sadṛśasamāgamanena parasparānurāgeṇa ca svamahimā prakāśita ityarthaḥ/ upari ca tatra tatra kaverdaivamadanayorānukūlyakathanasaṃrambho'nusandheyaḥ/

original: antarnagare nagarasyāntaḥ, madhye ityarthaḥ/ antargṛha itivat/ evetyatrāgamanasyācintitatvaṃ prakāśayati/ kāñciditi tasya cittakhedaparihārāya viśeṣānākhyānaṃ lokataḥ śanaiḥ śroṣyatīti/ adhikamiti abhilāṣamūlasya tasya pūrvamevānuvṛtteridānīṃ cittodvegasyādhikyamāśaṅkamāna ityarthaḥ/

original: itomukhamāgamanasya hetumāha - avalokitāniveditakusumākarodyānavṛttāntaḥ avalokitayā jñāpitaḥ kusumākarodyāne yo vṛttāntaḥ ``ajja kasaṇacaüddasi tti'' ityādisūcito mālatīmādhavagamanarūpo yasya saḥ/ tvaritataramiti sapadi savidhagatatve samāśvāsanasya śakyatvādatiśīghramityarthaḥ/ parāpatan āgacchan/
analyzed: itas mukham āgamanasya hetum āha avalokitā nivedita kusumākara udyāna vṛttāntaḥ avalokitayā jñāpitaḥ kusumākara udyāne yaḥ vṛttāntaḥ ajja tti ityādi sūcitaḥ mālatī mādhava gamana rūpaḥ yasya saḥ tvaritataram iti sapadi savidha gata tve samāśvāsanasya śakya tvāt ati śīghram iti arthaḥ parāpatan āgacchan

original: evakāreṇa yādṛcchikatvād daivasaṅghaṭitatvaṃ dyotyate/ śārdūlāvaskandagocaraṃ vyāghrāvapātasya viṣayabhūtāmiti mahāvyasanamagnatvaṃ, abhijātakanyakāmiti rūpaveṣavinayādibhirmahati kule jātā kumārī cetyanumitāmiti dayanīyatvaṃ anabhisandhipūrvakatvaṃ ca tatpūrvadṛṣṭatvāt svaprayatnasya vyañjayati/
analyzed: eva kāreṇa yādṛcchika tvāt daiva saṅghaṭita tvam dyotyate śārdūla avaskanda gocaram vyāghra avapātasya viṣaya bhūtām iti mahā vyasana magna tvam abhijāta kanyakām iti rūpa veṣa vinaya ādibhiḥ mahati kule jātā kumārī ca iti anumitām iti dayanīya tvam anabhisandhi pūrvaka tvam ca tat pūrva dṛṣṭa tvāt sva prayatnasya vyañjayati

original: gocaraṃ kanyakāmiti niyataliṅgatvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam/ abhyavapannavān anugṛhītavān/
analyzed: gocaram kanyakām iti niyata liṅga tvāt sāmānādhikaraṇyam abhyavapannavān anugṛhītavān

original: vimṛśataḥ kāñciditi chāditā kāsau vārteti nirūpayata ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: vimṛśataḥ kāñcid iti chāditā kā asau vārttā iti nirūpayataḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tāṃ vārtāṃ vaidagdhyāt kāmandakīmukhena prakāśayati kaviḥ/ svagatam/ vṛttena niṣpannena,
analyzed: tām vārtām vaidagdhyāt kāmandakī mukhena prakāśayati kaviḥ svagatam vṛttena niṣpannena

original: ``vṛttassa nau saṅgatayorvanānte''
analyzed: vṛttaḥ sa nau saṅgatayoḥ vanānte

original: itivat/ bhavitavyamiti makarandasya vacanādanumīyamānatvaṃ vyañjayati/ pūrvamevāmātyena sahaivaṃ kartavyamiti svayaṃkṛtasaṅketatvāt tayorvimarśanaṃ jñātvā vaimanasyaparihārāyāha - prakāśam/ diṣṭivṛddhyā daivasampadā/ vardhito'si ānandito'si ``diṣṭhiā baḍhḍhasi ṇaṃ bhaṇāṇi'' ityādinā/
analyzed: iti vat bhavitavyam iti makarandasya vacanāt anumīyamāna tvam vyañjayati pūrvam eva amātyena saha evam kartavyam iti svayaṃkṛta saṅketa tvāt tayoḥ vimarśanam jñātvā vaimanasya parihārāya āha prakāśam diṣṭi vṛddhyā daiva sampadā vardhitaḥ usi ānanditaḥ usi diṣṭhiā baḍhḍhasi nam bhaṇāṇi ityādinā

original: so'yamiti makarandasya cetanopalambhena yo'smākaṃ harṣahetuḥ so'yaṃ kālaḥ/ prītidāyasya pāritoṣikadānasya/ yadā diṣṭyā vardhate tadānīmeva tasyaucityāditi bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: saḥ yam iti makarandasya cetanā upalambhena yaḥ smākam harṣa hetuḥ saḥ ayam kālaḥ prīti dāyasya pāritoṣika dānasya yadā diṣṭyā vardhate tadānīm eva tasya aucityāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathāvidhena bhagavatīvacasā nirastāśaṅka āha - yadvyāletyādi/ yadvyālavraṇitasuhṛtpramohamugdhaṃ duṣṭamṛgeṇa vraṇitasya janitakṣatasya suhṛdaḥ pramohena mūrcchayā mugdhaṃ mohitam/ saujanyāt śobhanahṛdayo janaḥ sujanaḥ, tasyaiva paraduḥkheṣu duḥkhitatvamiti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: tathāvidhena bhagavatī vacasā nirasta āśaṅkaḥ āha yat vyāla ityādi yat vyāla vraṇita suhṛd pramoha mugdham duṣṭa mṛgeṇa vraṇitasya janita kṣatasya suhṛdaḥ pramohena mūrcchayā mugdham mohitam saujanyāt śobhana hṛdayaḥ janaḥ su janaḥ tasya eva para duḥkheṣu duḥkhita tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: tasya bhāvaḥ saujanyaṃ, tasmāddhetoriti hetvantarābhāvaṃ sūcayan madayantikādibhyaḥ trapayā parasparānurāgamūlatvaṃ chādayati/ vihitavatī kṛtavatī/ ``vipūrvo dhāñ karotyarthe'' iti vacanāt vipūrvasya dhāño niṣṭhā/ gatavyathaṃ śamitahṛdayaduḥkhaṃ, vihitavatī/ yat yasmāt tat tasmāt/ kāmamityavadhāraṇe,
analyzed: tasya bhāvaḥ saujanyam tasmāt hetoḥ iti hetu antara abhāvam sūcayan madayantika ādibhyaḥ trapayā paraspara anurāga mūla tvam chādayati vihitavatī kṛtavatī vipūrvaḥ karoti arthe iti vacanāt vipūrvasya dhāñaḥ niṣṭhā gata vyatham śamita hṛdaya duḥkham vihitavatī yat yasmāt tat tasmāt kāmam iti avadhāraṇe

original: ``kāmaṃ karṇāntaviśrānte viśāle tasya locane''/
analyzed: kāmam karṇa anta viśrānte viśāle tasya locane

original: itivat/ pūrṇapātravṛttyā pāritoṣikaprakāreṇa/
analyzed: iti vat pūrṇa pātra vṛttyā pāritoṣika prakāreṇa

original: ``utsaveṣu suhṛdbhiryad balādākṛṣya gṛhyate/
analyzed: utsaveṣu suhṛdbhiḥ yat balāt ākṛṣya gṛhyate

original: vastramālyādi tatpūrṇapātraṃ pūrṇānakaṃ ca tat//''
analyzed: vastra mālya ādi tat pūrṇa pātram pūrṇa ānakam ca tat

original: iti vaijayantī/ svīkartuṃ svamananyādhīnaṃ kartum/ hṛdayaṃ manaḥ/ jīvitaṃ prāṇāṃśca/ yato mohena gataṃ hṛdayaṃ prasthitaṃ jīvitaṃ cānayaiva prakṛtau sthāpitaṃ, atastaddvayaṃ pūrṇapātraṃ svīkartuṃ prabhavatyeveti bahirupacāraśabdatvena pratipādyāntarmama hṛdayeśvarī jīviteśvarī ceyameva, tato'dhikaṃ kimanyad dīyatāmiti vyañjayati/
analyzed: iti vaijayantī svīkartum svam ananya adhīnam kartum hṛdayam manaḥ jīvitam prāṇān ca yatas mohena gatam hṛdayam prasthitam jīvitam ca anayā eva prakṛtau sthāpitam atas tat dvayam pūrṇa pātram svīkartum prabhavati eva iti bahis upacāra śabda tvena pratipādya antar mama hṛdaya īśvarī jīvita īśvarī ca iyam eva tatas adhikam kim anyat dīyatām iti vyañjayati

original: yadvyālavraṇiteti sāmadānokteḥ saṅgrahaḥ//1//
analyzed: yat vyāla vraṇitā iti sāma dāna ukteḥ saṅgrahaḥ

original: tadubhayaṃ jānānā vidagdhā tanmukhabhūtā sakhī tadanuguṇamevottaramāha - pratīṣṭaḥ khalu naḥ priyasakhyā ayaṃ prasādaḥ/ pratīṣṭaḥ svīkṛtaḥ/ khalviti nirṇaye/ na iti tatra sannihitānāṃ madayantikādīnāṃ grahaṇam, asmākam/ priyasakhyā, ayaṃ hṛdayajīvitapradānarūpaḥ, prasādaḥ anugrahaḥ/ anugrahe khalvevamupacāraḥ prayujyate iti vācyo'rthaḥ/
analyzed: tat ubhayam jānānā vidagdhā tad mukha bhūtā sakhī tad anuguṇam eva uttaram āha pratīṣṭaḥ khalu naḥ priya sakhyā ayam prasādaḥ pratīṣṭaḥ svīkṛtaḥ khalu iti nirṇaye naḥ iti tatra sannihitānām madayantikā ādīnām grahaṇam asmākam priya sakhyāḥ ayam hṛdaya jīvita pradāna rūpaḥ prasādaḥ anugrahaḥ anugrahe khalu evam upacāraḥ prayujyate iti vācya ūrthaḥ

original: vyaṅgyastu pratīṣṭaḥ, na tu pratīṣyata iti ciranivṛttatvaṃ sūcayati/ naḥ priyasakhyeti satatapārśvavartinībhirasmābhirayamartho viditacara eva/ ayaṃ prasādaḥ hṛdayajīvitayostvadīyayoriyamīśvarī ityevaṃrūpa iti/
analyzed: vyaṅgyaḥ tu pratīṣṭaḥ na tu pratīṣyate iti cira nivṛtta tvam sūcayati naḥ priya sakhyā iti satata pārśva vartinībhiḥ asmābhiḥ ayam arthaḥ vidita caraḥ eva ayam prasādaḥ hṛdaya jīvitayoḥ tvadīyayoḥ iyam īśvarī iti evaṃrūpaḥ iti

original: tathoktaṃ viditvā camatkaroti - jānāti mahābhāgadheyo jano ramaṇīyaṃ mantrayitum/ [mahābhāgadheyaḥ] mahad bhāgadheyaṃ sukṛtaṃ yasya, rūpādibhistasyānumitatvāt sa tathāvidho, loke jano ramaṇīyaṃ mugdhavidagdhasādhāraṇatayā vācyavyaṅgyabhaṅgyāliṅgitatvena sundaram/ [mantrayituṃ] bhaṇitumityarthaḥ/
analyzed: tathā uktam viditvā camatkaroti jānāti mahā bhāgadheyaḥ janaḥ ramaṇīyam mantrayitum mahā bhāgadheyaḥ mahat bhāgadheyam su kṛtam yasya rūpa ādibhiḥ tasya anumita tvāt sa tathāvidhaḥ loke janaḥ ramaṇīyam mugdha vidagdha sādhāraṇa tayā vācya vyaṅgya bhaṅgī āliṅgita tvena sundaram mantrayitum bhaṇitum iti arthaḥ

original: pūrvavimarśanamevānuvartamānaṃ mālatyāḥ strīsvabhāvakātaratayā pitṛvicikitsayā ca śaṅkitahṛdayāyāḥ prakāśayati - svagatam/ kiṃ nāma makarandenodvegakāraṇaṃ śrutaṃ bhavet/ udvegakāraṇam mādhavasyetyarthāt/ bhavediti saṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ/
analyzed: pūrva vimarśanam eva anuvartamānam mālatyāḥ strī svabhāva kātara tayā pitṛ vicikitsayā ca śaṅkita hṛdayāyāḥ prakāśayati svagatam kim nāma makarandena udvega kāraṇam śrutam bhavet udvega kāraṇam mādhavasya iti arthāt bhavet iti saṃbhāvanāyām liṅ

original: tadvimarśaṃ bhaṅgyāchinatti kaviḥ - praviśya puruṣa iti/ sāmānyoktirviśeṣe tātparyābhāvāt, tadvārtāmātra eva tātparyāt/ madhyamapātramiti ca pratīyate, prabhuputryāṃ brāhmaṇyāṃ ca dūtyenādhamasyāgantumayuktatvād uttamasya ca preṣyatvānupapatteḥ/ ataśca saṃskṛtavyavahāraḥ/ jyāyān agrajo, bhrātā/ parameśvareṇa rājñā/
analyzed: tad vimarśam bhaṅgyā āchinatti kaviḥ praviśya puruṣaḥ iti sāmānyoktiḥ viśeṣe tātparya abhāvāt tad vārtā mātraḥ eva tātparyāt madhyama pātram iti ca pratīyate prabhu putryām brāhmaṇyām ca dūtyena adhamasya āgantum ayukta tvāt uttamasya ca preṣya tva anupapatteḥ atas ca saṃskṛta vyavahāraḥ jyāyān agrajaḥ bhrātā parameśvareṇa rājñā

original: paraṃ viśvāsam adhikaṃ visrambham/ asmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tasyānumatameveti niścayāt/ āviṣkurvatā loke prakāśayatā/ svayameva bhūrivasorasannidhāvityarthaḥ/ pratipāditā dattā/
analyzed: param viśvāsam adhikam visrambham asmābhiḥ kṛtam tasya anumatam eva iti niścayāt āviṣkurvatā loke prakāśayatā svayam eva bhūrivasoḥ asannidhau iti arthaḥ pratipāditā dattā

original: ``viśrāṇanaṃ vitaraṇaṃ sparśanaṃ pratipādanam''ṃ/
analyzed: viśrāṇanam vitaraṇam sparśanam pratipādanam

original: ityamaraḥ/ sambhāvayāmaḥ mahotsavakāraṇena pūjayāmaḥ/ prasādaṃ rājña iti/ arthāt kāñciditi chāditāṃ prakāśayati/
analyzed: iti amaraḥ sambhāvayāmaḥ mahā utsava kāraṇena pūjayāmaḥ prasādam rājñaḥ iti arthāt kāñcid iti chāditām prakāśayati

original: iyaṃ sā yā mayāntarnagare śruteti sūcitā, sā/ iyamanena puruṣeṇa prakāśitetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: iyam sā yā mayā antar nagare śrutā iti sūcitā sā iyam anena puruṣeṇa prakāśitā iti arthaḥ

original: vaivarṇyaṃ bhinnamukhavarṇatām/ ``praviśya puruṣaḥ'' ityādi ``vaivarṇyaṃ nāṭayataḥ'' ityantaṃ nirodhanaṃ, puruṣavacasā samāgamāśānirodhanāt/
analyzed: vaivarṇyam bhinna mukha varṇa tām praviśya puruṣaḥ ityādi vaivarṇyam nāṭayataḥ ityantam nirodhanam puruṣa vacasā samāgama āśā nirodhanāt

original: sakhi! tvaṃ khalvekanagarādhivāsena pāṃsukrīḍanāt prabhṛti priyasakhī bhaginī ca/ sāṃprataṃ punarasmākaṃ gṛhasya maṇḍanaṃ jātāsi/ [ekanagarādhivāsena] samānadeśavāsād visrambhasnehabhūmitayā, priyasakhī bhaginī ca/ mamāsīditi śeṣaḥ/ khalu prasiddhau/
analyzed: sakhi tvam khalu eka nagara adhivāsena pāṃsu krīḍanāt prabhṛti priya sakhī bhaginī ca sāṃpratam punar asmākam gṛhasya maṇḍanam jātā asi eka nagara adhivāsena samāna deśa vāsāt visrambha sneha bhūmi tayā priya sakhī bhaginī ca mama āsīt iti śeṣaḥ khalu prasiddhau

original: pāṃsukrīḍanāt prabhṛti sikatābhirvedikādikaṃ kṛtvā yat krīḍanaṃ vihāraḥ, tata ārabhyeti śaiśavopalakṣaṇam/ ``ekadeśanivāso vā snehasya hetavaḥ'' iti, ``sahapāṃsukrīḍāparicayapeśalaḥ sakhījanaḥ'' iti harṣacaritokteḥ/ sāmpramadya punarviśeṣo'pyastītyarthaḥ/ jyeṣṭhabhāryātvena santatasannidhānādasmadgṛhasya bhūṣaṇamapi jātāsītyarthaḥ/
analyzed: pāṃsu krīḍanāt prabhṛti sikatābhiḥ vedikā ādikam kṛtvā yat krīḍanam vihāraḥ tatas ārabhya iti śaiśava upalakṣaṇam eka deśa nivāsaḥ vā snehasya hetavaḥ iti saha pāṃsu krīḍā paricaya peśalaḥ sakhī janaḥ iti harṣacarita ukteḥ sāmpram adya punar viśeṣaḥ api asti iti arthaḥ jyeṣṭha bhāryā tvena santata sannidhānāt asmad gṛhasya bhūṣaṇam api jātā asi iti arthaḥ

original: bhrāturiti/ makarandasya priyatvādasyā mādhavo dharmato bhrātaiveti tattvakathanam, nandanasyeti pratibhāsācchalaprayogaḥ/
analyzed: bhrātuḥ iti makarandasya priya tvāt asyāḥ mādhavaḥ dharmataḥ bhrātā eva iti tattva kathanam nandanasya iti pratibhāsāt chala prayogaḥ

original: maugdhyāt tadajānānā prativakti-yuṣmākamāśiṣaḥ prasādena/ [yuṣmākaṃ] gurutvād bahuvacanam/ [āśiṣaḥ] yuṣmābhirasmāsu yā svastigīḥ prayuktā tasyāḥ, prasādena anugraheṇa/ vardhāmaha iti vipariṇāmena yojanā/ sakhi lavaṅgike! bharitā no manorathāḥ yuṣmākaṃ lābhena/ bharitāḥ pūrṇāḥ/
analyzed: maugdhyāt tat a jānānā prativakti yuṣmākam āśiṣaḥ prasādena yuṣmākam guru tvāt bahuvacanam āśiṣaḥ yuṣmābhiḥ asmāsu yā svasti gīḥ prayuktā tasyāḥ prasādena anugraheṇa vardhāmahe iti vipariṇāmena yojanā sakhi lavaṅgike bharitāḥ naḥ manorathāḥ yuṣmākam lābhena bharitāḥ pūrṇāḥ

original: manorathāḥ yadā nandanasya mālatīvivāhārthaṃ prayatna ārabdhaḥ tadāprabhṛti kadā mālatī lavaṅgikādibhiḥ sahāsmākaṃ gṛhamalaṅkariṣyatītyādaraḥ saṅkalpāḥ kṛtāḥ/
analyzed: manorathāḥ yadā nandanasya mālatī vivāha artham prayatnaḥ ārabdhaḥ tadā prabhṛti kadā mālatī lavaṅgikā ādibhiḥ saha asmākam gṛham alaṅkariṣyati iti ādaraḥ saṅkalpāḥ kṛtāḥ

original: pūrvavacchalenāha-sakhi asmākamiti mantrayitavyam/ asmākaṃ manorathāḥ yuṣmākaṃ nandanādīnāṃ lābhāt pūrṇā iti vaktavyamiti bāhyo'rthaḥ/ mādhavāya mālatīpradānaniścayādasmākaṃ manorathāḥ pūrṇāḥ, na tu yuṣmākamityāntaraḥ/
analyzed: pūrvavat chalena āha sakhi asmākam iti mantrayitavyam asmākam manorathāḥ yuṣmākam nandana ādīnām lābhāt pūrṇāḥ iti vaktavyam iti bāhyaḥ ṛthaḥ mādhavāya mālatī pradāna niścayāt asmākam manorathāḥ pūrṇāḥ na tu yuṣmākam iti āntaraḥ

original: sakhi buddharakṣite! ehi mahotsavaṃ sambhāvayāmaḥ/
analyzed: sakhi buddha rakṣite ehi mahā utsavam sambhāvayāmaḥ

original: ``ramaṇīyorjitaṃ daivādadya darśanam'' ityuktasya darśanasya phalaṃ bhaṅgyā prakāśayati - bhagavati yathā hṛdayabharitodvahavismayānandasundarāghūrṇitadhīraparyantamanoharāḥ paryasyante madayantikāmakarandayordalitendīvaramāṃsalacchavayo dṛṣṭisambhedāstathā manye manorathanirvṛttasamāgamāvetāviti/
analyzed: ramaṇīya ūrjitam daivāt adya darśanam iti uktasya darśanasya phalam bhaṅgyā prakāśayati bhagavati yathā hṛdaya bharita udvaha vismaya ānanda sundara āghūrṇita dhīra paryanta manoharāḥ paryasyante madayantikā makarandayoḥ dalita indīvara māṃsala chavayaḥ dṛṣṭi sambhedāḥ tathā manye manoratha nirvṛtta samāgamau etau iti

original: yadi pūrvameva mayā jīvitamamokṣyata tadā jugupsitametanna niravartiṣyateti jīvitaṃ pratyasūyā vyajyate/ ata idānīmapi jīvitatyāga eva śreyānityabhiprāyaḥ/ nirvyūḍhaṃ ca niṣkaruṇatayā kāpālikatvaṃ tātasya/ [kāpālikatvaṃ] vividhajīvopahāranirdayāḥ pāṣaṇḍaviśeṣāḥ kāpālikāḥ tadbhāvaḥ kāpālikatvam/
analyzed: yadi pūrvam eva mayā jīvitam amokṣyata tadā jugupsitam etat na niravartiṣyata iti jīvitam pratyasūyā vyajyate atas idānīm api jīvita tyāgaḥ eva śreyān iti abhiprāyaḥ nirvyūḍham ca niṣkaruṇa tayā kāpālika tvam tātasya kāpālika tvam vividha jīva upahāra nirdayāḥ pāṣaṇḍa viśeṣāḥ kāpālikāḥ tad bhāvaḥ kāpālika tvam

original: ṛ niṣkaruṇatayā iyaṃ mama duhitā varākī yāvajjīvaṃ duḥkhamanubhokṣyata ityanālocya svakāryakaraṇāttātaḥ sākṣātkāpālika eva jāta ityarthaḥ/ pariniṣṭhito daivasya dāruṇasamārambhasadṛśaḥ pariṇāmaḥ/ pariniṣṭhitaḥ sampūrṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ prayojanam/ tat kamupālabhe mandabhāgyā, kaṃ vā aśaraṇā śaraṇaṃ pratipadye/
analyzed: niṣkaruṇa tayā iyam mama duhitā varākī yāvajjīvam duḥkham anubhokṣyate iti an ālocya sva kārya karaṇāt tātaḥ sākṣāt kāpālikaḥ eva jātaḥ iti arthaḥ pariniṣṭhitaḥ daivasya dāruṇa samārambha sadṛśaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pariniṣṭhitaḥ sampūrṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ prayojanam tat kam upālabhe mandabhāgyā kam vā aśaraṇā śaraṇam pratipadye

original: taditi pitari daive caivaṃbhūtayorityarthaḥ/ [kaṃ upālabhe] kimevamanucitaṃ tvayā kriyata iti kamadhikṣipāmi/ upālambhayogye pitari krauryadarśanāt/ kaṃ vā[aśaraṇā] arakṣitṛkā ahaṃ, [śaraṇaṃ pratipadye] rakṣakatvenāśraye/ āśrayaṇīyasya daivasyātyantavailomyādityarthaḥ/

analyzed: jānāmi tām khalu vārtām iti ārabhya prāṇa vyayena api mayā vidheyaḥ iti antasya bhagavatī vacanasya pratyeya tvāt iti āśaṃkya apāya śaṅkayā pratikṣipati āśvāsana mātram manaḥ paryavasthāpana mātram mātra śabdaḥ uvadhāraṇe tena tāvat eva na paramārthataḥ tat iti arthaḥ tatra hetuḥ sahaja sneha ārdra hṛdayā akṛtrima vātsalya dravībhūta manāḥ iti

original: mādhavasyeti bhrātṛputratvasvasaṃvardhitatvaśikṣitatvādihetubhirgāḍhasnehāspadatvaṃ pratīyate/ anyathā vailakṣyādaniṣṭaṃ kimapyācariṣyatīti tatparihārāyeti bhāvaḥ/ tadvacanasyāpi svayamevāśvāsanamātramiti pratikṣiptatvānniravalambanatvamālocyāha - sodvegaṃ udvegaḥ duḥkhātiśayajanito manaḥkṣobhaḥ tatsahitam/ hanteti viṣāde/
analyzed: mādhavasya iti bhrātṛ putra tva sva saṃvardhita tva śikṣita tva ādi hetubhiḥ gāḍha sneha āspada tvam pratīyate anyathā vailakṣyāt aniṣṭam kim api ācariṣyati iti tad parihārāya iti bhāvaḥ tad vacanasya api svayam eva āśvāsana mātram iti pratikṣipta tvāt niravalambana tvam ālocya āha sa udvegam udvegaḥ duḥkha atiśaya janitaḥ manaḥ kṣobhaḥ tad sahitam hantā iti viṣāde

original: saṃśayitajanmasāphalyaḥ janmanyekaḥ sa eva mahotsava iti mālatīprāptereva janmaphalatvena svayamadhyavasitatvāt tadrūpajanmasaphalatvaṃ saṃśayitaṃ sandigdhaṃ yasya/ saṃśayitetyanena kāmisvabhāvādāśāyāḥ kiñcidacchedaḥ prakāśyate/ pravartaḥ praṇaṣṭaḥ/ niṣphalajanmanaḥ praṇaṣṭakalpatvāditi bhāvaḥ/ ``saṃvarttaḥ pralayaḥ kalpaḥ'' ityamaraḥ/
analyzed: saṃśayita janma sāphalyaḥ janmani ekaḥ saḥ eva mahā utsavaḥ iti mālatī prāpteḥ eva janma phala tvena svayam adhyavasita tvāt tad rūpa janma saphala tvam saṃśayitam sandigdham yasya saṃśayita iti anena kāmi svabhāvāt āśāyāḥ kiñcid acchedaḥ prakāśyate pravartaḥ praṇaṣṭaḥ niṣphala janmanaḥ praṇaṣṭa kalpa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ saṃvarttaḥ pralayaḥ kalpaḥ iti amaraḥ

original: tat kiṃ karttavyamiti cintāprārambhaḥ/ vicintyeti cintāsamāptiḥ/ cintayā nirṇītamarthamāha - na khalviti/ khaluravadhāraṇe/ mahāmāṃsavikrayāt mahāmāṃsamiti naramāṃsasya bhairavatantrasiddhā saṃjñā/ tathā prabodhacandrodaye``mastiṣkāktavasābhighāritamahāmāṃsāhutirjuhvatām/''

original: ityādi/ tasya vikrayo nāma/ ``kalpoktakrameṇa dīkṣitasya vaśyākarṣaṇādiṣvanyatamaphalāpekṣiṇaḥ puruṣasya kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrajanyāṃ mahāśmaśānaṃ gatvā svaśastrakṛttena nirddoṣeṇa naramāṃsena bhūtavetālādibhyo niṣkrayatayā dattena svābhimatasvīkaraṇam/
analyzed: ityādi tasya vikrayaḥ nāma kalpa ukta krameṇa dīkṣitasya vaśyā ākarṣaṇa ādiṣu anyatama phala apekṣiṇaḥ puruṣasya kṛṣṇa caturdaśī rajanyām mahā śmaśānam gatvā sva śastra kṛttena nirddoṣeṇa nara māṃsena bhūta vetāla ādibhyaḥ niṣkraya tayā dattena sva abhimata svīkaraṇam

original: tataśca jhaṭiti phalasiddhiḥ'' ityāgamāt, sāhasikānāṃ tathānubhavaśravaṇācca tatra saṃjātapratyaya āha - mahāmāṃsāvikrayāt/ anyadupāyāntaraṃ viśiṣṭamupāyaṃ sukhasādhanahetum/ priyāsamāgamarūpasya svakāryasyetyarthāt/ ``na khalu mahāmāṃsavikrayādanyad'' ityādi niyatāptyavasthā/
analyzed: tatas ca jhaṭiti phala siddhiḥ iti āgamāt sāhasikānām tathā anubhava śravaṇāt ca tatra saṃjāta pratyayaḥ āha mahāmāṃsā vikrayāt anyat upāya antaram viśiṣṭam upāyam sukha sādhana hetum priyā samāgama rūpasya sva kāryasya iti arthāt na khalu mahāmāṃsā vikrayāt anyat ityādi niyata āpti avasthā

original: prakāśamiti mahāmāṃsavikrayaṃ karttavyatvena nirṇīya svamākūtamapahnuvāno madayantikāmakarandayorākāreṅgitābhyāṃ dṛṣṭamanurāgaṃ praśnavyājena prakāśayati makarandaṃ vañcayitvaikākinaḥ svasya niśi śmaśānapraveśāya tamanyato vyākṣeptum/ api madayantikāyā utkaṇṭhate tāṃ sarāgaṃ smarati kim/
analyzed: prakāśam iti mahāmāṃsa vikrayam karttavya tvena nirṇīya svam ākūtam apahnuvānaḥ madayantikā makarandayoḥ ākāra iṅgitābhyām dṛṣṭam anurāgam praśna vyājena prakāśayati makarandam vañcayitvā ekākinaḥ svasya niśi śmaśāna praveśāya tam anyatas vyākṣeptum api madayantikāyāḥ utkaṇṭhate tām sa rāgam smarati kim

original: iti smṛteḥ/ anayā nīce ghṛṇayā nāyakasya śobhākhyaḥ sāttvikaguṇaḥ prakāśitaḥ/
analyzed: iti smṛteḥ anayā nīce ghṛṇayā nāyakasya śobhā ākhyaḥ sāttvika guṇaḥ prakāśitaḥ

original: ``hīne ghṛṇādhike spardhā śobhāyāṃ śauryadakṣatā/''
analyzed: hīne ghṛṇā adhike spardhā śobhāyām śaurya dakṣa tā

original: iti vacanāt/ sakrodhamiti - tadapakārānusandhānāt krodhavikāramabhinīyetyarthaḥ/ taditi tasmādyato'haṃ jīvāmītyarthaḥ/ avaśyamavyabhicaritaṃ kapālakuṇḍalākopasya kapālakuṇḍaleti na tu madityanena prasiddhaprabhāvatvaṃ dyotayati/ vilasitaṃ vipākam/
analyzed: iti vacanāt sa krodham iti tad apakāra anusandhānāt krodha vikāram abhinīya iti arthaḥ tat iti tasmāt yatas ham jīvāmi iti arthaḥ avaśyam avyabhicaritam kapāla kuṇḍala ākopasya kapāla kuṇḍala iti na tu mat iti anena prasiddha prabhāva tvam dyotayati vilasitam vipākam

original: uktamarthaṃ nidarśanenopapādayati - śāntiḥ kuta ityādi/ śāntirmanaso nirvṛtiḥ kutaḥ kasmāddhetoḥ, sadā śaṅkāspadatvenodvignatvāt, bhujaṅgaśatroḥ nāgamithunāt pumāṃsaṃ hatavataḥ/ yasmin viṣaye, amuktānuśayā aparityaktadīrghadveṣā/
analyzed: uktam artham nidarśanena upapādayati śāntiḥ kutas ityādi śāntiḥ manasaḥ nirvṛtiḥ kutas kasmāt hetoḥ sadā śaṅkā āspada tvena udvigna tvāt bhujaṅga śatroḥ nāga mithunāt pumāṃsam hatavataḥ yasmin viṣaye amukta anuśayā aparityakta dīrghadveṣā

original: ``paścāttāpe tvanuśayo dīrghadveṣānubandhayoḥ/''
analyzed: paścāttāpe tu anuśayaḥ dīrgha dveṣa anubandhayoḥ

original: iti vaijayantī/ sadā nityam evakāro bhinnakramaḥ, jāgartyeva na nidrātyeva, ``jāgṛ nidrākṣaye'' iti dhātuḥ, avahitaiva chidrānveṣiṇī vartata iti yāvat/ daṃśāya daṃśanārtham/ niśātadaṃṣṭrākoṭiḥ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāgrā, viṣodgāraguruḥ garalodvamanena gurvī apratihatasāmarthyā, bhujaṅgī hatasya nāgasya virahavidhurā sahacarī nāgī/
analyzed: iti vaijayantī sadā nityam eva kāraḥ bhinnakramaḥ jāgarti eva na nidrāti eva nidrā kṣaye iti dhātuḥ avahitā eva chidra anveṣiṇī vartate iti yāvat daṃśāya daṃśana artham niśāta daṃṣṭrā koṭiḥ tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭra agrā viṣa udgāra guruḥ garala udvamanena gurvī apratihata sāmarthyā bhujaṅgī hatasya nāgasya viraha vidhurā sahacarī nāgī

original: atra vaidharmyeṇa dṛṣṭānto'laṅkāraḥ, kāpālikasya taddhanturmādhavasya tatpraticikīrṣośca svasyāḥ ``tadavaśya''miti vākyoktānāṃ bimbabhūtānāṃ padmokteḥ bhujaṅgena tacchatruṇā bhujaṅgyā ca pratibimbitasya sphuṭatvāt/ ``anubhaviṣyasī''tyuktasya kuta iti vaidharmyeṇa samarthanācca vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntatvam/
analyzed: atra vaidharmyeṇa dṛṣṭānta ulaṅkāraḥ kāpālikasya tad hantuḥ mādhavasya tad praticikīrṣoḥ ca svasyāḥ tat avaśyam iti vākya uktānām bimba bhūtānām padma ukteḥ bhujaṅgena tad śatruṇā bhujaṅgyā ca pratibimbitasya sphuṭa tvāt anubhaviṣyasi iti uktasya kutas iti vaidharmyeṇa samarthanāt ca vaidharmya dṛṣṭānta tvam

original: athavā pūrvavākyamanapekṣya paryālocane aprastutapraśaṃsā, prastutasyārthasya aprastutamukhena gamyamānatvāt, atiśayoktirvā prakṛtasyārthasya samena nigīryādhyavasānāt/ avaśyamanubhaviṣyasītyādi virodhanam, saṃrabdhokteḥ//1//
analyzed: athavā pūrva vākyam an apekṣya paryālocane aprastuta praśaṃsā prastutasya arthasya aprastuta mukhena gamyamāna tvāt atiśayoktiḥ vā prakṛtasya arthasya samena nigīrya adhyavasānāt avaśyam anubhaviṣyasi ityādi virodhanam saṃrabdha ukteḥ

original: atha ``nandanāya rājñā pratipāditā'' iti pūrvaprastutasya mālatīvivāhotsavasyānusandhānaṃ karoti kaviḥ nāyakakāryahetoḥ - naipathye/ he rājāna ityādi/ ityādiśatīti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ/ ādeśaprakāraḥ - he rājāna iti/
analyzed: atha nandanāya rājñā pratipāditāḥ iti pūrva prastutasya mālatī vivāha utsavasya anusandhānam karoti kaviḥ nāyaka kārya hetoḥ naipathye he rājānaḥ ityādi iti ādiśati iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ ādeśa prakāraḥ he rājānaḥ iti

original: rājagrahaṇaṃ cakravartinā padmāvatīśvareṇa pravartitatvād utsavasya pratāpānurāgāvanatāḥ sāmantā eva bhṛtyakṛtyaṃ vahantīti dyotanārtham/ caramavayasāṃ caramamantimaṃ vayo jīvanakālo yeṣām, navatiṃ varṣāṇyatītānāṃ daśamīsthānāmiti yāvat/ vṛddhatvoktyā dharmajñatvaṃ lakṣyate/ anyathā paśvādivad vṛddhatvavyavahārasyaivāyogyatvāt/
analyzed: rāja grahaṇam cakravartinā padmāvatī īśvareṇa pravartita tvāt utsavasya pratāpa anurāga avanatāḥ sāmantāḥ eva bhṛtya kṛtyam vahanti iti dyotana artham carama vayasām caramam antimam vayaḥ jīvana kālaḥ yeṣām navatim varṣāṇi atītānām daśamī sthānām iti yāvat vṛddha tva uktyā dharma jña tvam lakṣyate anyathā paśu ādi vat vṛddha tva vyavahārasya eva ayogya tvāt

original: ``na sā sabhā yatra na santi vṛddhāḥṣṭana te vṛddhā ye na vadanti dharmam/''
analyzed: na sā sabhā yatra na santi te vṛddhāḥ ye na vadanti dharmam

original: iti vacanāt, teṣāṃ vaidikalaukikācāraniṣṇātānām/ ājñayā niyogena/ kartavyeṣu anuṣṭheyeṣu karmasu, toraṇastambhottambhanavitānabandhanamaṇḍapamaṇḍanādiṣu, sañcaradhvaṃ pravartadhvam/ ājñayā sañcaradhvamiti ``samastṛtīyāyuktāt''
analyzed: iti vacanāt teṣām vaidika laukika ācāra niṣṇātānām ājñayā niyogena kartavyeṣu anuṣṭheyeṣu karmasu toraṇa stambha uttambhana vitāna bandhana maṇḍapa maṇḍana ādiṣu sañcaradhvam pravartadhvam ājñayā sañcaradhvam iti samaḥ tṛtīyā yuktāt

original: (1-3-54) ityātmanepadam/ śravaṇasubhagaṃ arthānusandhānaṃ vināpyākarṇane maṅgalasādhanaṃ puṇyāhasvastivācanādikaṃ sahasranāmādikaṃ cetyarthaḥ, bhūmidevāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ, teṣāmeva yājane'dhikārāt, paṭhantu adhīyantām/
analyzed: iti ātmanepadam śravaṇa subhagam artha anusandhānam vinā api ākarṇane maṅgala sādhanam puṇyāha svastivācana ādikam sahasranāma ādikam ca iti arthaḥ bhūmidevāḥ brāhmaṇāḥ teṣām eva yājana adhikārāt paṭhantu adhīyantām

original: citraṃ gītavādyanartanādivividhaprakāraviśiṣṭam, nānāvacananivahaiḥ bahuprakārā hariharapitāmahaskandakandarparudrāṇīndrāṇyādidevatāviśeṣastutiparā vacanasamūhā yeṣāṃ taiḥ, naṭanartakatālaravacaracāraṇādibhirityarthaḥ, [ceṣṭyatāṃ] pravartyatām, maṅgalebhyaḥ abhyudayārthamāyurārogyaiśvaryasaubhāgyaputrasampadādiphalasādhanatvabhedād bahuvacanam/
analyzed: citram gīta vādya nartana ādi vividha prakāra viśiṣṭam nānā vacana nivahaiḥ bahu prakārāḥ hari hara pitāmaha skanda kandarpa rudrāṇī indrāṇī ādi devatā viśeṣa stuti parāḥ vacana samūhāḥ yeṣām taiḥ naṭa nartaka tāla rava cara cāraṇa ādibhiḥ iti arthaḥ ceṣṭyatām pravartyatām maṅgalebhyaḥ abhyudaya artham āyuḥ ārogya aiśvarya saubhāgya putra sampad ādi phala sādhana tva bhedāt bahuvacanam

original: pratyāsannaḥ tricaturanāḍikāntaritaḥ, tvarayatitarāṃ atiśayena protsāhayati, asmān īdṛśeṣu vyāpāreṣviti śeṣaḥ, janyayātrāpraveśaḥ janyānāṃ jāmātṛbandhūnāṃ yātrā, utsavārthamāgamanaṃ kanyāvaraṇārthaṃ vā/
analyzed: pratyāsannaḥ tri catura nāḍikā antaritaḥ tvarayatitarām atiśayena protsāhayati asmān īdṛśeṣu vyāpāreṣu iti śeṣaḥ janya yātrā praveśaḥ janyānām jāmātṛ bandhūnām yātrā utsava artham āgamanam kanyā varaṇa artham vā

original: ``jñātibhṛtyā navoḍhāyā janyā snigdhā varasya vā/''
analyzed: jñāti bhṛtyāḥ na voḍhāyāḥ janyā snigdhā varasya vā

original: iti, ``śāntiyātrā varanimantraṇe'' iti ca vaijayantī/ śāntiśabdāprayogaḥ prasiddhyā/ athavā janyaśabdopalakṣitā varayātrā janyayātrā, ``daundubhī varayātrāyāṃ'' iti vaijayantī/ svakṛtasaṃvaraṇārthaṃ caiva taditi mantavyam/ tasyāḥ praveśaḥ/ praviśatyasminniti tadyogo muhūrtaḥ praveśaḥ/ tvarayatitarāmiti tatsamarthācaraṇāduktiḥ/
analyzed: iti śānti yātrā vara nimantraṇe iti ca vaijayantī śānti śabda a prayogaḥ prasiddhyā athavā janya śabda upalakṣitā vara yātrā janya yātrā daundubhī vara yātrāyām iti vaijayantī sva kṛta saṃvaraṇa artham ca eva tat iti mantavyam tasyāḥ praveśaḥ praviśati asmin iti tad yogaḥ muhūrtaḥ praveśaḥ tvarayatitarām iti tad samartha ācaraṇāt uktiḥ

original: atrārthāntaranyāso'laṅkāraḥ, kartavyasañcaraṇādeḥ kāryasya praveśatvaraṇena kāraṇena samarthanāt/ aprastutapraśaṃsā vā, sañcaraṇādinā kāryeṇa kāraṇasya mālatīvivāhotsavasya sūcanāt//2//
analyzed: atra artha antaranyāsaḥ ulaṅkāraḥ kartavya sañcaraṇa ādeḥ kāryasya praveśa tvaraṇena kāraṇena samarthanāt aprastuta praśaṃsā vā sañcaraṇa ādinā kāryeṇa kāraṇasya mālatī vivāha utsavasya sūcanāt

original: yāvat yasmin kālāvadhau, cakāro vākyārbhasamuccaye, saṃbandhinaḥ kanyādvāreṇa sambandhamabhilaṣanto bandhavaḥ, ``pulastyaḥ pulahapraṣṭhāśca sambandhinaḥ'' iti murāryuktavat, na parāpatanti nāgacchanti, tāvat tasmin kālāvadhau ca/ nagaradevateti deśādhipatyāt kuladevatātvāccāvaśyābhigamanīyatvamāha/
analyzed: yāvat yasmin kāla avadhau cakāraḥ vākya arbha samuccaye saṃbandhinaḥ kanyā dvāreṇa sambandham abhilaṣantaḥ bandhavaḥ pulastyaḥ pulaha praṣṭhāḥ ca sambandhinaḥ iti murāri ukta vat na parāpatanti na āgacchanti tāvat tasmin kāla avadhau ca nagara devatā iti deśa ādhipatyāt kula devatā tvāt ca avaśya abhigamanīya tvam āha

original: avighnamaṅgalāya niṣpratyūhāya kalyāṇāya, anyathā``pratibadhnāti hi śreyaḥ pūjyapūjāvyatikramaḥ/
analyzed: avighna maṅgalāya niṣpratyūhāya kalyāṇāya anyathā pratibadhnāti hi śreyaḥ pūjya pūjā vyatikramaḥ

original: iti nyāyādvighnopapatteḥ/ anyacceti ādiśatikriyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ/ gṛhītasaviśeṣamaṇḍana iti vibhūtiprapañcena pūrvameva bhūṣitatvādidānīmutsavārthaṃ sātiśayaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ svīkṛtaṃ yena, pratīkṣatāṃ nirgacchantīṃ pratipālayatu/ ānuyātrikaḥ anugamanaṃ sevanaṃ prayojanaṃ yena, parijana ityarthaḥ/
analyzed: iti nyāyāt vighna upapatteḥ anyat ca iti ādiśati kriyā anukarṣaṇa arthaḥ gṛhīta sa viśeṣa maṇḍanaḥ iti vibhūti prapañcena pūrvam eva bhūṣita tvāt idānīm utsava artham sa atiśayam bhūṣaṇam svīkṛtam yena pratīkṣatām nirgacchantīm pratipālayatu ānuyātrikaḥ anugamanam sevanam prayojanam yena parijanaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ``he rājāna'' ityādi prarocanā, bhāvino'rthasya siddhatvena pradarśanāt/
analyzed: he rājānaḥ ityādi prarocanā bhāvinā ūrthasya siddha tvena pradarśanāt

original: bhavatvityardhāṅgīkāre, vṛthā samanuṣṭhīyatāṃ, mayā punarmūlamevocchetsyata iti bhāvaḥ/ itaḥ asmāt/ parikarmasthāneṣu jananiveśanaṃ, tattatkarmasu tattajjanavyāpāraṇamityādirupasaṃskāraḥ parikarma, tatra satvarāṇāṃ sambhrāntānāṃ pratīhārāṇāṃ vetrapāṇīnām/ ``dvāsthedvārau pratīhārau'' iti vaijayantī/ śatena saṅkulāt saṅkaṭāt/
analyzed: bhavatu iti ardha aṅgīkāre vṛthā samanuṣṭhīyatām mayā punar mūlam eva ucchetsyate iti bhāvaḥ itas asmāt parikarmasthāneṣu jana niveśanam tad tad karmasu tad tad jana vyāpāraṇam iti ādiḥ upasaṃskāraḥ parikarma tatra satvarāṇām sambhrāntānām pratīhārāṇām vetra pāṇīnām pratīhārau iti vaijayantī śatena saṅkulāt saṅkaṭāt

original: mādhavāpakāraṃ prati mādhavasya vipriyaṃ lakṣīkṛtya/ abhiniviṣṭā nirbandhavatī, chidrānveṣiṇīti yāvat/
analyzed: mādhava apakāram prati mādhavasya vipriyam lakṣīkṛtya abhiniviṣṭā nirbandhavatī chidra anveṣiṇī iti yāvat

original: atītasya kāpālikavadhasya, āgāminaḥ kapālakuṇḍalānimittasya vyasanasya mālatīnirgamasya ca sūcitatvād viṣkambhamupasaṃharati - niṣkrāntā/
analyzed: atītasya kāpālika vadhasya āgāminaḥ kapāla kuṇḍala a nimittasya vyasanasya mālatī nirgamasya ca sūcita tvāt viṣkambham upasaṃharati niṣkrāntā

original: //iti viṣkambhakaḥ//
analyzed: iti viṣkambhakaḥ

original: atha sarasavastvabhinayāyāṅkamārabhate - tataḥ praviśati kalahaṃsa iti/
analyzed: atha sa rasa vastu abhinayāya aṅkam ārabhate tatas praviśati kalahaṃsaḥ iti

original: kalahaṃsaḥ - āṇattohnītyādi/ ājñapto'smi nagaradevatāgarbhagṛhavartinā samakarandena nāthena/ samakarandeneti makarandasāhitye tātparyamāha/ nāthena svāminā mādhavenetyarthaḥ/ jānīhi tāvaditomukhaṃ pravṛttā mālatī na veti/ itomukhaṃ etaddeśoddeśavalitavadanamiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam/ pravṛttā prasthitā/
analyzed: kalahaṃsaḥ āṇattaḥ hni ityādi ājñaptaḥ asmi nagara devatā garbhagṛha vartinā sa makarandena nāthena sa makarandena iti makaranda sāhitye tātparyam āha nāthena svāminā mādhavena iti arthaḥ jānīhi tāvat itomukham pravṛttā mālatī na vā iti itomukham etat deśa uddeśa valita vadanam iti kriyā viśeṣaṇam pravṛttā prasthitā

original: athavā neti apāyaśaṅkitvaṃ dyotayati, ``śreyāṃsi bahuvighnāni'' iti nyāyāt/ anayā coktibhaṅgyā sābhiprāyakāmandakīsaṅketapūrvameva nagaradevatāgarbhagṛhavartitvamanayoḥ, tanniyogācca mālatyāstadupagamanamiti prakāśyate/ ``avighnamaṅgalāya gantavyami''ti ca vacanaṃ saṅghaṭayati/ tadyāvadānandayiṣyāmi priyavacanenetyarthaḥ/
analyzed: athavā na iti apāya śaṅki tvam dyotayati śreyāṃsi bahu vighnāni iti nyāyāt anayā ca ukti bhaṅgyā sa abhiprāya kāmandakī saṅketa pūrvam eva nagara devatā garbhagṛha varti tvam anayoḥ tad niyogāt ca mālatyāḥ tat upagamanam iti prakāśyate avighna maṅgalāya gantavyam iti ca vacanam saṅghaṭayati tat yāvat ānandayiṣyāmi priya vacanena iti arthaḥ

original: yāvacchabdo vākyālaṅkāre avadhāraṇe vā/
analyzed: yāvat śabdaḥ vākya alaṅkāre avadhāraṇe vā

original: atha garbhagṛhavartitvena sūcitatvāt nāyakopanāyakayoḥ praveśamāha - tataḥ praviśata iti/
analyzed: atha garbhagṛha varti tvena sūcita tvāt nāyaka upanāyakayoḥ praveśam āha tatas praviśataḥ iti

original: phalāphalayoranyataraniścayājjīvanamaraṇayoranyataraṃ niṣkṛṣya hṛṣṭo dhṛṣṭa āha- mālatyā ityādi/ prathamāvalokanadinād ādyadarśanopalakṣitamadanodyānagamanadivasamādiṃ kṛtvā, vistāriṇaḥ svayameva rūpamādhuryadarśanamātreṇa vardhiṣṇoḥ/ vistāribhirityapapāṭhaḥ, bhūya ityādīnāṃ vaiyarthyāpātāt/
analyzed: phala aphalayoḥ anyatara niścayāt jīvana maraṇayoḥ anyataram niṣkṛṣya hṛṣṭaḥ dhṛṣṭaḥ āha mālatyāḥ ityādi prathama avalokana dināt ādya darśana upalakṣita madana udyāna gamana divasam ādim kṛtvā vistāriṇaḥ svayam eva rūpa mādhurya darśana mātreṇa vardhiṣṇoḥ vistāribhiḥ iti apapāṭhaḥ bhūyas ityādīnām vaiyarthya āpātāt

original: bhūyaḥ paścāt, snehaviceṣṭitaiḥ premakāryaiḥ pravṛttiviśeṣaiḥ, citralekhanabakulamālādhāraṇadānaśravaṇavaivarṇyamaraṇasamayamuktāśaṅkapralāpaprabhṛtibhirityarthaḥ, mṛgadṛśā mālatyā, parāṃ koṭiṃ nītasya agrabhūmimāropitasya,
analyzed: bhūyas paścāt sneha viceṣṭitaiḥ prema kāryaiḥ pravṛtti viśeṣaiḥ citra lekhana bakula mālā dhāraṇa dāna śravaṇa vaivarṇya maraṇa samaya muktā āśaṅka pralāpa prabhṛtibhiḥ iti arthaḥ mṛga dṛśā mālatyā parām koṭim nītasya agra bhūmim āropitasya

original: puṣpasadṛśasvabhāvāḥ, yathā kusumāni sadayamādāya śirasi dhāritāni paramaṃ sukhaṃ śobhātiśayaṃ ca janayanti, na tu karatalakalanaṃ vidṛḍhataraṃ kṣamante, tathā yoṣito'pyupalālanīyāḥ, na tu kadarthanīyāḥ ityarthaḥ,
analyzed: puṣpa sadṛśa svabhāvāḥ yathā kusumāni sadayam ādāya śirasi dhāritāni paramam sukham śobhā atiśayam ca janayanti na tu kara tala kalanam vidṛḍhataram kṣamante tathā yoṣitaḥ api upalālanīyāḥ na tu kadarthanīyāḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ``naisargikī surabhiṇaḥ kusumasya siddhā mūrdhni sthitirna musalairavatāḍanāni/'' ityukteḥ/ hi prasiddhau/ yoṣita iti strīmātrasyāyaṃ dharmaḥ, kiṃ punaḥ kanyānāmityarthaḥ, kanyāvisrambhaṇaprakaraṇapaṭhitatvāt/ sukumāropakramāḥ mṛdūpāyānuṣṭheyasamprayogāḥ, bhavantīti śeṣaḥ/

original: tā yoṣitaḥ, turviśeṣe, anadhigataviśvāsaiḥ aprāptavisrambhaiḥ prasabhaṃ balātkāreṇa upakramyamāṇāḥ bhoktumārabhyamāṇāḥ, sadyastatkṣaṇa eva saṃprayogavidveṣiṇyaḥ puruṣasaṃsargavirāgaśīlāḥ/ tato'pi vairasyamāha - puruṣadveṣiṇyo veti/ samprayogamantareṇāpi puruṣamātrameva darśanasparśanādiṣvapi dveṣṭuṃ śīlaṃ yāsāṃ tāḥ, vā/ itissūtrasamāptau/

original: ``kusume''tyādeḥ ``puruṣadveṣiṇyo ve''tyantasya sūtrasya pāṭhānukaraṇād ``anukaraṇe tu sarveṣāṃ'' ityukteḥ sādhutvāt saṃskṛtatvaṃ, ``evaṃ kila'' ityādeḥ svoktitvāt prākṛtatvaṃ ceti mantavyam, na tu saṃskṛtāśrayaṇena, tasya svavacanaviṣayatvāt/

original: sāsramiti satyatvabhāvanāvaidagdhyamāha/ gṛhe gṛhe puruṣāḥ striya udvahanti/ na ca ko'pi lajjāprasādhanamanaparāddhamugdhasvabhāvaṃ kulakumārījanaṃ prabhavāmīti vāganalena prajvālayati/ udvahanti vivahanti/ ko'pītyuttamo madhyamo'dhamo vetyarthaḥ/ lajjaiva prasādhanamalaṅkāro yasya, ``sphuṭamabhibhūṣayati striyastrapaiva'' ityukteḥ/
analyzed: sa asram iti satya tva bhāvanā vaidagdhyam āha gṛhe gṛhe puruṣāḥ striyaḥ udvahanti na ca kopi lajjā prasādhanam anaparāddha mugdha svabhāvam kula kumārī janam prabhavāmi iti vāc analena prajvālayati udvahanti vivahanti kopī iti uttamaḥ madhyamaḥ adhamaḥ vā iti arthaḥ lajjā eva prasādhanam alaṅkāraḥ yasya sphuṭam abhibhūṣayati striyaḥ trapā eva iti ukteḥ

original: anaparāddhaḥ kadācidapyaparādharahitaḥ, tatra hetuḥ mugdhaḥ hariṇyāderivākṛtrimaḥ svabhāvo yasya/ kaḥ khalvanunmattaḥ śiśuṣu ca paśuṣu ca kanyājaneṣu ca maugdhyādaniṣṭamāceṣṭamāneṣvapi nikṛṣṭaroṣāviṣṭatvamācarediti bhāvaḥ/ kulakumārījanaṃ praśaste vaṃśe jātaṃ kulasya paripālakaṃ ca kanyājanam/
analyzed: anaparāddhaḥ kadācid api aparādha rahitaḥ tatra hetuḥ mugdhaḥ hariṇī ādeḥ iva akṛtrimaḥ svabhāvaḥ yasya kaḥ khalu anunmattaḥ śiśuṣu ca paśuṣu ca kanyā janeṣu ca maugdhyāt aniṣṭam āceṣṭamāneṣu api nikṛṣṭa roṣa āviṣṭa tvam ācaret iti bhāvaḥ kula kumārī janam praśaste vaṃśe jātam kulasya paripālakam ca kanyā janam

original: anena trivargasya tadāyattatvāt paṇyanārīvadānukūlye parigrahaḥ, prātikūlye parityāgaśca kiṃ śakyate vā ayaṃ upapanno veti dyotyate/ prabhavāmi prabhuḥ svāmyahamasmīti/ itirhetau, anena hetunā na punastadgatenāparādhaleśena śeṣeṇāśeṣabhūtasya vastunaḥ parilālane parilolane ko vā nivārayitā, tathāpi dvitīyā koṭiranuciteti bhāvaḥ/

original: iti mahābhāratokteḥ/ prajvālayati pradīptaṃ karoti/ prajvālayati na punardahatītyuktiḥ puṭapākavat sarvadā manaḥkvāthajananād abhasmīkaraṇācca/ ete khalu te hṛdayaśalyanikṣepāḥ āmaraṇaṃ saṃsmaryamāṇadussahāḥ paragṛhanivāsavairāgyakāriṇo mahāparibhavāḥ/ khaluḥ prasiddhau/
analyzed: iti mahābhārata ukteḥ prajvālayati pradīptam karoti prajvālayati na punar dahati iti uktiḥ puṭapāka vat sarvadā manaḥ kvātha jananāt abhasmīkaraṇāt ca ete khalu te hṛdaya śalya nikṣepāḥ āmaraṇam saṃsmaryamāṇa dussahāḥ para gṛha nivāsa vairāgya kāriṇaḥ mahā paribhavāḥ khalu prasiddhau

original: ete lokairdṛśyamānāḥ āmaraṇaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ hṛdayaśalyanikṣepāḥ manasi śalyasya śaraphalasya nikhananarūpāḥ, antarvyathākāritvāt/ saṃsmaryamāṇatve dussahāḥ anubhavasamayādapi smaraṇe smaraṇe marmacchidaḥ/ paraśabdena svapitṛgehādanya ucyate/ anyadīyabhavananivāse vairāgyānnirvedaṃ kartuṃ śīlaṃ yeṣām/ mahāparibhavāḥ tāḍanādibhyo'pyadhikāstiraskārāḥ/
analyzed: ete lokaiḥ dṛśyamānāḥ āmaraṇam yāvajjīvam hṛdaya śalya nikṣepāḥ manasi śalyasya śara phalasya nikhanana rūpāḥ antar vyathā kāri tvāt saṃsmaryamāṇa tve dussahāḥ anubhava samayāt api smaraṇe smaraṇe marma chidaḥ para śabdena sva pitṛ gehāt anyaḥ ucyate anyadīya bhavana nivāse vairāgyāt nirvedam kartum śīlam yeṣām mahā paribhavāḥ tāḍana ādibhyaḥ api adhikāḥ tiraskārāḥ

original: taduktyabhiprāyaṃ lavaṅgikā jānānā api ajānānevāha - vayaṃ kathamātmagataṃ jānīmaḥ/ ātmagataṃ manasi sthitaṃ kathaṃ jānīmaḥ ``vacanaliṅgā hi vakturabhiprāyāḥ'' iti nyāyāt tvayā kathite jñāyate tvadākūtaṃ, tat kathyatāmityarthaḥ/ ``asantāṃ'' iti pāṭhe asat mithyābhūtamityarthaḥ, tasya mūlābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: tad ukti abhiprāyam lavaṅgikā jānānā api ajānānā iva āha vayam katham ātma gatam jānīmaḥ ātma gatam manasi sthitam katham jānīmaḥ vacana liṅgāḥ hi vaktuḥ abhiprāyāḥ iti nyāyāt tvayā kathite jñāyate tvad ākūtam tat kathyatām iti arthaḥ asantām iti pāṭhe asat mithyā bhūtam iti arthaḥ tasya mūla abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ``ṇa vāāgāṃ'' iti pāṭhe vāggatamapi kathaṃ na jānīma iti tadvivakṣitārthakhaṇḍanāya sābhiprāyaṃ vacanaṃ, tvadbhrātudagśśīlyamantareṇa na kiñcinmūlaṃ tacca tadvācaiva vyaktamityarthaḥ/
analyzed: iti pāṭhe vāc gatam api katham na jānīmaḥ iti tad vivakṣita artha khaṇḍanāya sa abhiprāyam vacanam antareṇa na kiñcid mūlam tat ca tad vācā eva vyaktam iti arthaḥ

original: upālambhamūlaṃ vivṛṇoti - yadidānīṃ tasmin mahānubhāve mādhave kimapi kila mālatyā vāṅmātramāsīt tasmin sarvalokasyātibhūmiṃ gataḥ pravādaḥ, tat khalvetad vijṛmbhate/ tasminniti śārdūlavimardasamayadṛṣṭatvāt mādhavānubhavābhinayaḥ/ athavā tasminniti śaṅkarapurapraveśābhinayaḥ/

original: mugdhāyāḥ prabodhanāyāhatuḥ - sakhi mālati/ sakṛdukte prabodhamadṛṣṭvā punaḥ sanirbandhamāhatuḥ - nanu bhaṇāvaḥ/ nanuḥ saṃvāde/ kiṃ tvayā na śrūyate, sakhi mālatītyāvāṃ nanu vadāva ityarthaḥ/ dirukte'pi tasyāḥ prabodhamadṛṣṭvā sotkampaṃ apāyaśaṅkayā sasādhvasamāhatuḥ - bhagavati paritrāyasva/ ciraniruddhaniśvāsaniścalamasyā hṛdayam/

original: paritrāyasva jīvanopāyānuṣṭhānena rakṣetyarthaḥ/ ciraniruddhena bahukṣaṇastabdhena niśvāsena hetunā niścalaṃ niṣkampam/ niśvāsocchvāsapraveśanirgamasamaye hi tadanuguṇaṃ calati vakṣaḥsthalam/ hṛdayaspandanābhāve ca mṛtabhrāntijanakatvād bhayopapattirāvayoriti bhāvaḥ/ hā amātya! hā priyasakhi! dvāvapi yuvāṃ parasparasyāvasānasya kāraṇaṃ jātau/
analyzed: paritrāyasva jīvana upāya anuṣṭhānena rakṣa iti arthaḥ cira niruddhena bahu kṣaṇa stabdhena niśvāsena hetunā niścalam niṣkampam niśvāsa ucchvāsa praveśa nirgama samaye hi tad anuguṇam calati vakṣaḥ sthalam hṛdaya spandana abhāve ca mṛta bhrānti janaka tvāt bhaya upapattiḥ āvayoḥ iti bhāvaḥ hā amātya hā priya sakhi dvau api yuvām parasparasya avasānasya kāraṇam jātau

original: mālatyapāyādhigamenāmātyasya maraṇādhyavasāyāt, tadadhyavasāyaśravaṇena mālatyā mohācca parasparasyānyonyasyāvasānaṃ maraṇaṃ, tasya kāraṇaṃ heturjātāvityuktiḥ/

original: kathanasiddhamarthaṃ bhaṅgyā sūcayati - pakṣapātasthānaṃ snehātiśayaviṣayaḥ/ ādyaśiṣyā prathamaśiṣyā pradhānabhūtā vā, saudāminīti saṃjñā tāvatpuraiva mantravadāvartitā, idānīṃ tasyāḥ saṃjñinaḥ sambandho diṣṭyā gṛhīta iti bhāvaḥ/

original: siddhirbhavatu nāma tathāpi niṣkṛpāḥ kecana tatphalakṣayabhayena prāṇināṃ vyasaneṣu tānna viniyuñjate, tathā kāṭhinyamapi tava nāstītyāha - evaṃvidhaiḥ evamityanubhavābhinayaḥ, anubhūtasyāsmadanugrahasyaivaṃvidhaḥ prakāro yeṣāmityanena sadavidhurajanatrāṇatācchīlyamanumāyoktiḥ/

original: vilasitaiḥ krīḍitairityayatnasādhyatvamupakārasyābhimānābhāvaśca dyotyate/ parābhyavapattau na copamānaṃ tavetyāha - atibodhisattvaiḥ bodhisattvaṃ jinamunimatikrāntaiḥ/ ``atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā''

original: (vā. 1-4-79) iti samāsaḥ/ tasya paramakāruṇikatvena prasiddhāvapi śaṅkhacūḍādīnāṃ rakṣaṇe svātmatyāgarūpasya mahataḥ pātakasyānuṣṭhīyamānatvāt sukṛtaduṣkṛtayostulyaphalatvaṃ tadātvaduḥkhānubhūtiśca vidyate/ tava tu dīnarakṣaṇaphalamavaśiṣyate, na cātmā kadarthyata ityaho taccaritebhyastvaccaritāni dūrāddavīyāṃsi dyotanta iti bhāvaḥ/

original: ``buddhastu śrīghanaśśāstā bodhisattvo vināyakaḥ/''

original: ato'pi priyatamaṃ kāryaṃ niṣpannamityāha - samprītau samyak tvadviṣaye prasannau nṛpanandanau padmāvatīśvaro'mātyanandanaśca/ tayossaṃprītyabhāve niṣpannasya sarvasyāpi kāryasya vyasanodarkatvena gajasnānakalpatvamiti bhāvaḥ/
analyzed: atas api priyatamam kāryam niṣpannam iti āha samprītau samyak tvad viṣaye prasannau nṛpa nandanau padmāvatī īśvara umātya nandanaḥ ca tayoḥ saṃprīti abhāve niṣpannasya sarvasya api kāryasya vyasana udarka tvena gaja snāna kalpa tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: ataḥ paramasmādanyat preyaḥ priyatamaṃ vastu yat lipsitamityarthāt, tadapītyapinā siddhakāryavattasyāpyayatnasādhyatvaṃ svasyāḥ tatpriyānuṣṭhānaikatānatvaṃ ca dyotyate, ucyatāṃ kathyatām/ na punarupakramyatāmityanena mamedaṃ spṛhāyā viṣaya iti tadvacanānantarameva tatsiddhiṃ drakṣyasīti prakāśyate/
analyzed: atas param asmāt anyat preyaḥ priyatamam vastu yat lipsitam iti arthāt tat api iti apinā siddha kārya vat tasya api ayatna sādhya tvam svasyāḥ tad priya anuṣṭhāna ekatāna tvam ca dyotyate ucyatām kathyatām na punar upakramyatām iti anena mama idam spṛhāyāḥ viṣayaḥ iti tad vacana anantaram eva tad siddhim drakṣyasi iti prakāśyate

original: ``yatprāgeve''tyādinā labdhārthasthirīkaraṇāt kṛtiḥ/ ``yadaparaṃ preyastadapyucyatā''miti kāryārthasaṃharaṇāt kāryasaṃhāraḥ/ atra ca ``api nāma kalyāṇino''rityādinopakṣiptasya mālatīmādhavapāṇigrahaṇasya ``so vi saha aro māhavassa bālamittaṃ māraṃdo ṇaṃdaṇassa bhaïṇiaṃ madāntiaṃ jaï samuvvahaï takkhu māhavassa ahiaṃ piaṃ hoi''ti/
analyzed: yat prāk eva ityādinā labdha artha sthirīkaraṇāt kṛtiḥ yat aparam preyaḥ tat api ucyatām iti kārya artha saṃharaṇāt kārya saṃhāraḥ atra ca api nāma kalyāṇinoḥ ityādinā upakṣiptasya mālatī mādhava pāṇigrahaṇasya saḥ vi saha araḥ māhavassa bāla mittam māraṃdaḥ naṃdaṇassa bhaïṇiam mada antiam jañ samuvvahaï takkhu māhavassa ahiam piam hoiti

original: madayantikāmakarandapariṇayasya cādhikṛtatvādubhayasyāpi sādhitatvāt prakaraṇārthaparisamāptiḥ pratipāditā//23//
analyzed: madayantikā makaranda pariṇayasya ca adhikṛta tvāt ubhayasya api sādhita tvāt prakaraṇa artha parisamāptiḥ pratipāditā

original: atha mālatīprāptyaiva paramapuruṣārthasya trivargasya sādhitatvāttataḥ parasya lipsāviṣayasyābhāvāttadanuyuktamarthaṃ pratikṣipati - ataḥ paramapi priyamastīti/ ataḥ siddhādarthāt paramutkṛṣṭaṃ priyaṃ vastu, apirvirodhe, astīti kākvā praśnarūpayā na kiñcidastītyākṣepaḥ prakāśyate/ ``ataḥ paramapi priyamastī''ti vāñchitārthaprāptikathanād bhāṣaṇam/
analyzed: atha mālatī prāptyā eva parama puruṣa arthasya trivargasya sādhita tvāt tatas parasya lipsā viṣayasya abhāvāt tad anuyuktam artham pratikṣipati atas param api priyam asti iti atas siddhāt arthāt param utkṛṣṭam priyam vastu apiḥ virodhe asti iti kākvā praśna rūpayā na kiñcid asti iti ākṣepaḥ prakāśyate atas param api priyam asti iti vāñchita artha prāpti kathanāt bhāṣaṇam

original: tathāpi ataḥ parasya vastuno lipsāyā viṣayasyābhāve'pītyarthaḥ/ idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ vastu/ astviti prārthanāyāṃ loṭ/ anena ca lipsābhāve'pi mahāpuruṣānugrahasya sarvathā svīkartavyatvaṃ śreyassādhanatvāditi dyotayati/ nāṭakanyāyācceyamuktiḥ/ bharatavākyamiti/
analyzed: tathā api atas parasya vastunaḥ lipsāyāḥ viṣayasya abhāve api iti arthaḥ idam vakṣyamāṇam vastu astu iti prārthanāyām anena ca lipsā abhāve pi mahāpuruṣa anugrahasya sarvathā svīkartavya tvam śreyaḥ sādhana tvāt iti dyotayati nāṭaka nyāyāt ca iyam uktiḥ bharata vākyam iti

original: prakaraṇasya sākalyenābhinīya parisamāpitatvāt mādhavabhūmikāṃ parityaktavataḥ svaprakṛtimātraniṣṭhasya vacanam/ idaṃ vakṣyamāṇamityarthaḥ/ prārthanāprakāramāha - śivamastvityādi/ śivam abhyudayaḥ/ ajahikaviṣayānubhavasampattirityarthaḥ/ sarvajagatāṃ sarveṣāṃ śarīriṇām/
analyzed: prakaraṇasya sākalyena abhinīya parisamāpita tvāt mādhava bhūmikām parityaktavataḥ sva prakṛti mātra niṣṭhasya vacanam idam vakṣyamāṇam iti arthaḥ prārthanā prakāram āha śivam astu ityādi śivam abhyudayaḥ ajahika viṣaya anubhava sampattiḥ iti arthaḥ sarva jagatām sarveṣām śarīriṇām

original: tatra hetuḥ - parahitaniratāḥ paraśabdena svakāryatvāt kāraṇabhūtebhyaḥ svebhyo'nyeṣāmityucyate/
analyzed: tatra hetuḥ para hita niratāḥ para śabdena sva kārya tvāt kāraṇa bhūtebhyaḥ svebhyaḥ nyeṣām iti ucyate

original: ``tathāhi sarve tasyāsan parārthaikaphalā guṇāḥ/''
analyzed: tathā hi sarve tasya āsan parārtha eka phalāḥ guṇāḥ

original: itivat/ teṣāṃ hite śreyasi niratāḥ nitarāṃ ratā udyuktāḥ/ svaguṇaiḥ śabdādibhiḥ parahitaikaniṣṭhā iti yāvat/ teṣāṃ nyūnātireke jagatkṣobhasyāvaśyaṃbhāvāt/ bhūtagaṇāḥ ākāśādīnāṃ mahatāṃ bhūtānāṃ saṅghāḥ/
analyzed: itivat teṣām hite śreyasi niratāḥ nitarām ratāḥ udyuktāḥ sva guṇaiḥ śabda ādibhiḥ para hita eka niṣṭhāḥ iti yāvat teṣām nyūna atireke jagat kṣobhasya avaśyaṃbhāvāt bhūta gaṇāḥ ākāśa ādīnām mahatām bhūtānām saṅghāḥ

original: ``pañcānāmapi bhūtānāmutkarṣaṃ pupuṣurguṇāḥ''
analyzed: pañcānām api bhūtānām utkarṣam pupuṣuḥ guṇāḥ

original: ityuktam/ doṣā rāgadveṣalobhādayaḥ/ ``pravartamānalakṣaṇāḥ syurdoṣā rāgādayaśca te'' iti vacanāt/ nāśaṃ prayāntu dhīdhairyātmajñānādibhirapunarutthānāya vilayaṃ gacchantu/
analyzed: iti uktam doṣāḥ rāga dveṣa lobha ādayaḥ pravartamāna lakṣaṇāḥ syuḥ doṣāḥ rāga ādayaḥ ca te iti vacanāt nāśam prayāntu dhī dhairya ātma jñāna ādibhiḥ apunarutthānāya vilayam gacchantu

original: ``dhīdhairyātmādivijñānaṃ manodoṣauṣadhaṃ param''
analyzed: dhī dhairya ātma ādi vijñānam manaḥ doṣa auṣadham param

original: iti vacanāt/ sarvatra sarvadeśeṣu sarvāvasthāsu vā sukhī niśśeṣaduḥkhanivṛttyā niratiśayānandānubhavaviśiṣṭo bhavatu/ mithyājñānamūlasya rāgādeḥ samyak[j]jñānena nivṛttatvāt rāgādimūlasya ca duḥkharāśestannirasanenaiva nirastatvāt/
analyzed: iti vacanāt sarvatra sarva deśeṣu sarva avasthāsu vā sukhī niśśeṣa duḥkha nivṛttyā niratiśaya ānanda anubhava viśiṣṭaḥ bhavatu mithyājñāna mūlasya rāga ādeḥ nivṛtta tvāt rāga ādi mūlasya ca duḥkha rāśeḥ tad nirasanena eva nirasta tvāt

original: ``yadā sarve pramucyante kāmā ye'sya hṛdi sthitāḥ/
analyzed: yadā sarve pramucyante kāmāḥ hṛdi sthitāḥ

original: atha martyo'mṛto bhavatyatra brahma samaśnute''
analyzed: atha martyaḥ umṛtaḥ bhavati atra brahma samaśnute

original: ``abhayaṃ vai janaka prāpto'si'' ``tarati śokamātmavit'' ityādiśrutivacanaiḥ/ asyāstvāryāyāḥ pūrvārdhena abhyudayaprārthanā uttarārdhena niḥśreyasaprārthanā cāryasya parameśvaraṃ prati paramakāruṇikena kavinā kṛteti veditavyam/ ``tathāpīdamastu/ śivamastu sarvajagatā''mityādinā śubhaśaṃsanāt praśastiḥ/
analyzed: abhayam vai janaka prāptaḥ asi tarati śokam ātma vid ityādi śruti vacanaiḥ asyāḥ tu āryāyāḥ pūrva ardhena abhyudaya prārthanā uttara ardhena niḥśreyasa prārthanā ca āryasya parameśvaram prati parama kāruṇikena kavinā kṛtā iti veditavyam tathā api idam astu śivam astu sarva jagatām ityādinā śubha śaṃsanāt praśastiḥ

original: evamete pañca sandhayaścatuṣṣaṣṭyaṅgaiḥ pratipāditāḥ/ atra prakaraṇa ādau ``sānandami''ti, madhye ``vidhātā bhadranna'' iti, ante ``śivamastu sarvajagatāmi''ti ca prayogāt maṅgalopakramatvānmaṅgalamadhyatvānmaṅgalāntatvāccaitacchīlanaparāṇāṃ sakalasamīhitasampattiḥ prakāśitā/
analyzed: evam ete pañca sandhayaḥ catuṣṣaṣṭi aṅgaiḥ pratipāditāḥ atra prakaraṇe ādau sa ānandam iti madhye vidhātā bhadran naḥ iti ante śivam astu sarva jagatām iti ca prayogāt maṅgala upakrama tvāt maṅgala madhya tvāt maṅgala anta tvāt ca etad śīlana parāṇām sakala samīhita sampattiḥ prakāśitā

original: atra mādhava iti sākṣāllakṣmīpatirnārāyaṇa ucyate, ``śṛṅgāro viṣṇudaivatya''iti vacanāt śṛṅgāradevatā bhagavānevātra nāyaka ityanusandhānārtham/ mālatī tu saukumāryasaurabhyādiyogāllakṣmīḥ/ devarāta iti devaiḥ bhagavadavatāritārthaṃ bhūmāvavatāritatvāt kāśyapaḥ/ bhūrivasuriti anantaratnākaratvāt kṣīrasāgaraḥ/
analyzed: atra mādhavaḥ iti sākṣāt lakṣmīpatiḥ nārāyaṇaḥ ucyate śṛṅgāraḥ viṣṇu daivatyā eti vacanāt śṛṅgāra devatā bhagavān eva atra nāyakaḥ iti anusandhāna artham mālatī tu saukumārya saurabhya ādi yogāt lakṣmīḥ devarātaḥ iti devaiḥ bhagavat avatārita artham bhūmau avatārita tvāt kāśyapaḥ bhūrivasuḥ iti ananta ratna ākara tvāt kṣīrasāgaraḥ

original: makaranda iti ``raso vai saḥ'' ityādivacanāt paramānandarūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ/ madayantiketi mahāmāyātvena jaganmohanād bhavānī/ kāmandakīti kāmitārthadānasāmarthyād bhaktiḥ/ buddharakṣiteti buddhairvidvadbhiḥ paripālitatvāt sarasvatī/ avalokiteti prekṣāvadbhiḥ samyagālocitattvāt nītiḥ/ lavaṅkiketi parimalabahalatvāt kīrtiḥ/
analyzed: makarandaḥ iti rasaḥ vai saḥ iti ādi vacanāt paramānanda rūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ madayantikā iti mahāmāyā tvena jagat mohanāt bhavānī kāmandakī iti kāmita artha dāna sāmarthyāt bhaktiḥ buddha rakṣitā iti buddhaiḥ vidvadbhiḥ paripālita tvāt sarasvatī avalokitā iti prekṣāvadbhiḥ samyak ālocita ttvāt nītiḥ lavaṅkikā iti parimala bahala tvāt kīrtiḥ

original: kalahaṃsa iti madhurāvyaktoccāraḥ paramātmamantraḥ/ aghoraghaṇṭa iti aśāstravihitahiṃsāparatvādadharmaḥ/ kapālakuṇḍaleti hiṃsā/ saudāminīti prakāśātmikā jhaṭiti sphuraṇena sakalāndhakārapaṭalavighaṭanapaṭīyasī vidyetyādirupāsanopayuktā vāsanāpi mahākaverdaiṣṭikairanusandheyeti sakalamatimaṅgalam//24//
analyzed: kalahaṃsaḥ iti madhura avyakta uccāraḥ paramātma mantraḥ aghora ghaṇṭaḥ iti aśāstra vihita hiṃsā paratvāt adharmaḥ kapāla kuṇḍala iti hiṃsā saudāminī iti prakāśa ātmikā jhaṭiti sphuraṇena sakala andhakāra paṭala vighaṭana paṭīyasī vidyā ityādiḥ upāsana upayuktā vāsanā api mahā kaveḥ daiṣṭikaiḥ anusandheyā iti sakala matimaṅgalam

original: mālatīmādhavasyetthaṃ daśamāṅkārthacarcanam/
analyzed: mālatī mādhavasya ittham daśama aṅka artha carcanam

original: pūrṇajyotiḥprasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī//
analyzed: pūrṇajyotiḥ prasādena cakre pūrṇasarasvatī

original: //iti daśamo'ṅkaḥ//
analyzed: iti daśamaḥ ūṅkaḥ

analyzed: śubham astu
